ps2.1:0.1: suttantapiṭake khuddakanikāyo paṭisambhidāmaggo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
ps2.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
ps2.1:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhu āmantesi
ps2.1:1.5: ‘āvuso’ti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
ps2.1:2.1: yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattapattaṃ byākaroti, sabbo so catūhi maggehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
ps2.1:3.2: tassa samathapubbaṅgaṃ vipassanā bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati,
ps2.1:3.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:3.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti. anusayā byantīhonti.
ps2.1:4.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu vipasnāpubbaṅgaṃ samathaṃ bhāveti,
ps2.1:4.2: tassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati,
ps2.1:4.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:4.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
ps2.1:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu samathavippanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti,
ps2.1:5.2: tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati,
ps2.1:5.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:5.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
ps2.1:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhuno dhammuddhaccaviggahitaṃ mānasaṃ hoti,
ps2.1:6.2: so āvuso samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati,
ps2.1:6.4: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:6.5: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato pahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti.
ps2.1:7.1: yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattapattaṃ byākaroti, sabbo so imehi catūhi maggehi etesaṃ vā aññatarenāti.
ps2.1:8.3: tattha jāte dhamme aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.
ps2.1:8.8: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagaviriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.
ps2.1:9.2: dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi maggo sañjāyati, abhiniropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo maggo sañjāyati, pariggahaṭṭhena sammāvācā maggo sañjāyati, samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammākammanto maggo sañjāyati, vodānaṭṭhena sammāājīvo maggo sañjāyati, paggahaṭṭhena sammāvāyāmo maggo sañjāyati, upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammāsati maggo sañjāyati, avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi maggo sañjāyati.
ps2.1:10.1: “so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.” āsevatīti kathaṃ āsevati:
ps2.1:10.2: āvajjanto āsevati, jānanto āsevati, passanto āsevati, paccavekkhanto āsevati, cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto āsevati, saddhāya adhimuccanto āsevati, viriyaṃ paggaṇhanto āsevati, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento āsevati, cittaṃ samādahanto āsevati, paññāya pajānanto āsevati, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto āsevati, pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto āsevati, pahātabbaṃ pajahanto āsevati, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento āsevati, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto āsevati.
ps2.1:11.2: āvajjanto bhāveti, jānanto bhāveti, passanto bhāveti, paccavekkhanto bhāveti, cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto bhāveti, saddhāya adhimuccanto bhāveti, viriyaṃ paggaṇhanto bhāveti, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento bhāveti, cittaṃ samādahanto bhāveti, paññāya pajānanto bhāveti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto bhāveti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto bhāveti, pahātabbaṃ pajahanto bhāveti, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento bhāveti, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto bhāveti.
ps2.1:12.2: āvajjanto bahulīkaroti, jānanto bahulīkaroti, passanto bahulīkaroti, paccavekkhanto bahulīkaroti, cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto bahulīkaroti, saddhāya adhimuccanto bahulīkaroti, viriyaṃ, paggaṇhanto bahulīkaroti, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento bahulīkaroti, cittaṃ samādahanto bahulīkaroti, paññāya pajānanto bahulīkaroti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto bahulīkaroti, pariññeyaṃ parijānanto bahulīkaroti, pahātabbaṃ pajāhanto bahulīkaroti, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento bahulīkaroti, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:13.1: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti anusayā byattīhontī’ti kathaṃ saṃyojanā pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti:
ps2.1:13.14: arahattamaggena rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccaṃ avijjā
ps2.1:14.3: paṭinissaggānupassī assāsavasena, paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi,
ps2.1:14.4: tattha jāte dhamme aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā,
ps2.1:14.9: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anitivattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagaviriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.
ps2.1:15.2: dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi maggo sañjāyati, abhiniropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo maggo sañjāyati …pe…
ps2.1:16.1: “so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.” āsevatīti kathā āsevati:
ps2.1:17.1: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanā pahīyanti anusayā byattihontī’ti kathaṃ saññojanā pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti:
ps2.1:17.14: arahattamaggena rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccaṃ avijjā
ps2.1:18.2: aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā,
ps2.1:18.3: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānañca vossaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo
ps2.1:18.4: samādhi. iti paṭhamaṃ vipassanā pacchā samatho.
ps2.1:19.1: rūpaṃ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, rūpaṃ dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, rūpaṃ anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.
ps2.1:19.2: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānañca vossaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.
ps2.1:20.6: jarāmaraṇaṃ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhato …pe…
ps2.1:20.8: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānañca vossaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.
ps2.1:21.3: ārammaṇaṭṭhena, gocaraṭṭhena, pahānaṭṭhena, pariccāgaṭṭhena, vuṭṭhānaṭṭhena, vivaṭṭanaṭṭhena, santaṭṭhena, paṇītaṭṭhena, vimuttaṭṭhena, anāsavaṭṭhena, taraṇaṭṭhena, animittaṭṭhena, appaṇihitaṭṭhena, suññataṭṭhena, ekarasaṭṭhena, anativattanaṭṭhena, yuganaddhaṭṭhena.
ps2.1:22.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhārammaṇā, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhārammaṇā.
ps2.1:22.3: iti ārammaṇaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:23.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocaro.
ps2.1:23.3: iti gocaraṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:24.2: uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:24.3: iti pahānaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:25.2: uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pariccajato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pariccajato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:25.3: iti pariccāgaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:26.2: uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhe ca vuṭṭhahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:26.3: iti vuṭṭhānaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:27.2: uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vivaṭṭato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vivaṭṭato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:27.3: iti vivaṭṭanaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti. aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:28.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi santo hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā santā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:28.3: iti santaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:29.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi paṇīto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā paṇītā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:29.3: iti paṇītaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:30.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi kāmāsavā vimutto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā avijjāsavā vimuttā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:30.3: iti rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimutti. iti vimuttiṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:31.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi kāmāsavena anāvāso hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā avijjāsavena anāsavā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:31.3: iti anāsavaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:32.2: uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca tarato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca tarato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:32.3: iti taraṇaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:33.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbanimittehi animitto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbanimittehi animittā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:33.3: iti animittaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:34.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbapaṇidhīhi appaṇihito hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbapaṇidhīhi appaṇihitā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:34.3: iti appaṇihitaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:35.2: uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbābhinivesehi suñño hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbābhinivesehi suññā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:35.3: iti suññataṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganaddhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattanti.
ps2.1:35.6: bhāvetīti catasso bhāvanā: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anitivattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagaviriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā,
ps2.1:35.12: imehi soḷahi ākārehi samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti. evaṃ samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti.
ps2.1:36.2: aniccato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati, ‘obhāso dhammo’ti obhāsaṃ āvajjati. tato vikkhepo uddhaccaṃ.
